5 Iterative Improvement Heuristics

Most high quality GP solvers iteratively improve starting
solutions. We outline a variety of methods for this purpose, moving from very fine-grained localized
approaches to more global techniques.

5.1 Node-swapping Local Search

Local search is a simple and widely used metaheuristic for optimization that iteratively changes a solution by choosing a new one from a neighborhood. Defining the neighborhood and the selection strategy allows a wide variety of techniques.
